passage.label: tortured believing men women not repented punishment Hell punishment Burning Fire; believed righteous deeds gardens rivers flow great attainment; vengeance Lord severe; He originates creation repeats; Forgiving Affectionate; Honorable Owner Throne; Effecter what intends

arabicExcerpts.text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُواْ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمۡ يَتُوبُواْ فَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ ٱلۡحَرِيقِ
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ جَنَّـٰتٞ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡكَبِيرُ

mainSubject.label: Those who tortured believing men and women without repenting face the punishment of Hell and of the Burning Fire, while believers doing righteous deeds receive rivered gardens as the great attainment; the Lord's vengeance declared severe alongside His originating and repeating creation; He is named Forgiving and Affectionate, Honourable Owner of the Throne, Effecter of whatever He intends

notes: Wave 12 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the dominion-and-Witness affirmation (9) before the torturer-versus-believer verdict opens (10); P2 ends with the Effecter-of-what-He-intends attribute (16) before the soldiers' precedent begins (17); P3 runs through Pharaoh and Thamud, the encompassment statement and the closing Preserved-Slate affirmation (17-22).
